title: Bramble Union Ambusher
kicker: a road reclaimer who has never done this before, and it shows
hook: a road reclaimer who has never done this before, and it shows

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A mud-caked road reclaimer crouches under a patched hood, face half-swallowed by moss, bark plates, rope knots, and scavenged ward charms.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: All borrowed bravado stretched thin over raw fear. They rehearsed the hard line and forgot everything after it. Under the moss and bark plates is someone who would much rather be home.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: Parley path Capture/mercy branch Evidence that the road conflict is bigger than banditry
